findings_read_from_supplied_go_text_not_.finding: G.O.Ms.No.394 is dated 26-11-2014. It rescinds G.O.Ms.No.162 dated 30-03-2013 and restores sale-deed stamp duty prescribed by G.O.Ms.No.719 dated 30-07-2010, with immediate effect; the order text describes restoration to 5%.
findings_read_from_supplied_go_text_not_.limitation: This establishes the supplied order's stated change from 26-11-2014, not the rate for all deed types or for dates after later amendments.
